Paint Protection Film / AT Series

AT Super Matte Black

AT Super Matte Black is an automotive paint protection film in the AT Series, with a matte black finish and a brochure-listed thickness of 7.5 mil.

7.5 milMatte black
Inquire about this film

Availability, pricing and regional terms on confirmation.

THE DETAILS

Specifications

Finish
Matte black
Film thickness
7.5 mil
Brochure warranty period
5 years

This is the period printed in the supplied brochure, not confirmation of regional coverage. Confirm the applicable terms and installation requirements before purchase.

Material & application

  • TPU film construction
  • Heat-assisted scratch recovery described in the brochure
  • Impact and abrasion resistance described in the brochure

For automotive body panels. Confirm the selected film and finish with a qualified installer.

Installation & care

  • Avoid touching the film, especially its edges, for the first 3 days after installation.
  • The brochure recommends washing approximately one week after installation, once the film has fully dried.
  • Avoid brushes, abrasive compounds, abrasive sponges and adhesive items on the surface.
  • Have removal performed by a professional installer.

Storage

Store flat in the original packaging, away from direct sunlight and extreme temperatures. The brochure recommends 20 ± 2 °C and 40–60% relative humidity.
